EndfieldAnimationImporter 3.0.0

Appearance Mod Installation:
1. Extract the appearance archive.
2. Place its folder in the mod folder beside EAI.Launcher.exe.
3. Keep the original INI, mesh, texture and shader subfolders.

Open the mod folder from the EAI launcher's sidebar.

Appearance Hotkeys:
[F10]: Reload EFMI and save appearance settings
[F11]: Toggle appearance display
[F12]: Toggle this guide
[Ctrl]+[Alt]+[F10]: Reset appearance settings and reload

Mod Developer Hotkeys:
[Ctrl]+[F10]: Toggle Performance Monitor
[Ctrl]+[F11]: Disable custom shaders while held
[Ctrl]+[F12]: Toggle Shader Hunting Mode Guide

Press F10 to hide this message
